IssuerRegistry.note: Adds approveMint: the admin clears one exact set of mint parameters for one issuer. Keyed by NoteFactory.mintHash, so editing anything after approval produces a different hash and is refused.

NoteFactory.note: Requires an admin approval bound to the exact mint parameters.

MockUSDG.warning: TESTNET ONLY. Minting is unrestricted, so this token is worthless as money. On mainnet, point RepaymentVault at the real USDG instead.

SaleDesk.note: Primary offering desk. One instance serves every note; authority is read from each note's issuer(). No price can be set — a token is a claim on one unit of principal, so the desk computes par from the note's own terms. 0x9df0003b quoted zero for amounts that rounded down, giving those tokens away free; 0x3efB366e let the issuer override the price.

demoNote.terms: 1,000 USDG at 10% over the term; five instalments of 200 principal + 20 interest
demoNote.note_: Minted through the deployed factory to exercise the flow on a real network. One period has settled: supply fell from 1,000 to 800 tokens while shares stayed at 1,000, and 220 USDG became claimable.

demo.note_: Cleared with the database. Earlier notes remain on-chain under the superseded factories but are no longer indexed.
